body: Forward test of the valuation-temperature method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.52 (naive base rate 0.45) that: Genus Power's share price return from 20-Nov-2026 to 30-Jun-2027 beats the Nifty 50's price return. Evidence: screener.in 20-Nov-2026: price ₹266, P/E 11.9 vs its own 5-yr median P/E 38.3 (≈0.3× own median — 'cold'); ROCE 25.3%, ROE 30.9%; 52-wk range ₹207–359. Known flags (memdb event:GENUSPOWER:avoid-2026-11-19): CFO negative 3 years (smart-meter AMISP model), borrowings ~₹2,482 cr, FII 18.7%→7.4%. Nifty 50 close 20-Nov-2026: 25,800.6 (Yahoo ^NSEI). Reasoning: Valuation-temperature test of the cold end: a stock at ~0.3× its own median multiple with high reported ROE. Lesson L12 cuts both ways — cheap can stay cheap when cash conversion is poor, so we are only mildly above base. Resolution: YES if (Genus close on NSE 30-Jun-2027 ÷ 266.0) > (Nifty 50 close 30-Jun-2027 ÷ 25,800.6). Use the last trading day ≤30-Jun-2027; adjust Genus for any split/bonus; dividends ignored for both. Source: NSE/Yahoo Finance closes (GENUSPOWER.NS, ^NSEI); screener.in price. Resolve by 2027-06-30; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: A single Indian small cap beats the Nifty 50 over a ~7-month window roughly 45% of the time (return skew: the median small cap lags the index).
data.resolution_rule: YES if (Genus close on NSE 30-Jun-2027 ÷ 266.0) > (Nifty 50 close 30-Jun-2027 ÷ 25,800.6). Use the last trading day ≤30-Jun-2027; adjust Genus for any split/bonus; dividends ignored for both.

title: Paper call: Genus Power's share price return from 20-Nov-2026 to 30-Jun-2027 beats the Nifty 50's price return
